critical_code_review_comments: _briefing_meals groups by (day, tipo, place_key, orario) — correct; esigenze count is per-person per-group so a participant with two meals at same place/time only counts once per group (uses _persone set + esig_by_person) — good. Note: tipologia_servizio is kept per-group but not surfaced in the Line labels (only via title or 'Servizio' label elsewhere) — fine for current spec.

_briefing_lodgings uses struttura_id OR struttura_nome.lower() as key. If a lodging has only struttura_nome (no id), two slightly-different name casings would still collapse (fine). Occupanti esterni are included with the booking's dates but marked esterno; verified not present in current test scenario.
LodgingList.ospiti.sort by cognome then nome — matches spec. Order of camere by numeric room number is correct (int sort + non-numeric fallback).

Hospitality.jsx line 395: lodging row shows 'camera {numero}' only when numero_camera is set. Row 'Nessun pernottamento' or fallback '—' is only on missing fields subset — no stray '— / Hotel: —' lines.

Lodging.numero_camera field is Optional[str]; _compute_rooms strips+lower-cases numero_camera when building room keys so '101' and '101 ' are the same room (good). Empty numero stays as 'da assegnare' per structure — matches spec.

Request to run the LegacyHosp fallback path in a QA org with pre-published briefing versions could not be verified (no such legacy version exists in test_brf org). Recommend main agent spot-check one QA org version if any exists; the code path is static (MealsSection checks !days && legacy).
